Hand Held Terminal (HHT) Application is used in HHT Tablets (device s) as a part of computerization of train checking system with following main functionalities. 2. Downloading of charts to Hand Held device over GPRS and marking confirmed/RAC passengers as Boarded (Turned Up) or Not Turned up ( NT). 3. Sync with PRS System after train checking, for updating data on Occ upied and Not turned passengers and for allotting vacant berths. 2. SCOPE OF WORK 1. 1. Supply and commissioning of HHT Tablet devices (as per Technical s

pecification given in Annexure-1 of this special condition). 2. Repair/replace the faulty equipment within 72 hours at the respectiv e consignee locations. 3. Provide all support documents of OEM’s standard warranty. 4. Provide the list of all authorized service center of OEM available in Ju risdiction of South Central Railway. 5. Vendor has to provide all help in installation of the HHT Application on the device. 6. Any other provisions as specified in Annexure-6 attached with this bi d. 3. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT: Bidders shall upload EMD particulars or exemption documents in the re levant section of GeM while quoting the bid. Please refer clause (a) of t he bid document, clause 4 subclause xiii (m) and clause 2(l) of General Terms and Conditions on GeM hyperlinked with the bid document for fu rther details on Earnest Money Deposit. The EMD shall be submitted in Sealed Envelope with GeM bid number, date and Firms complete addre ss to Dy Chief Material Manager /General, Principal chief Material Mana ger Office, 6th Floor, Rail Nilayam , Secunderabad , Telengana- 500003 . 4.SECURITY DEPOSIT/ePBG DETAILS: The applicable ePBG is 5% of Contract value for the period mentioned i n Bid document. Security Deposit will be valid for 2 months beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations. a. Security deposit/ePBG has to be deposited after award of GeM co ntract in acceptable money instruments specified in Clause 2 (m) and Clause 7 of GeM GTC attached with bid. b. If Bidder fails to deposit ePBG within stipulated time frame and co ndition as specified in GeM GTC then contract may be cancelled by the buyer and Purchaser shall have right to levy damages from the supplie r for failing to comply with contractual conditions, not by way of penalt y, an amount equal to SD amount, as would have been submitted. The se damages shall be treated as recoveries outstanding against the Sell er and shall be dealt with accordingly. c. In addition to above, Buyer shall raise an incident through the inc ident management system of GeM against failure of submission of ePB G, for initiating stern action of Banning / Suspension as per clause 21 (i

i) sub clause (g) of GeM GTC. d. Seller's failure to submit Performance guarantee shall be treated as bad performance and will be dealt accordingly. e. Money Instrument shall be pledged in the name of PFA/SCR. 5. INSPECTION: As per Clause 5 of the Annexure-6 (Special Terms and Conditions enclo sed along with the Gem Bid). 6. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: This clause is in supersession of Past performance criteria in cl ause (4) of bid document. Past performance criterion shall be e valuated as per following condition. [A] The tenderer with past performance of satisfactory execution of co ntracts to SC Railway, or Other Zonal Railways/PUs for supply of the sa me / similar items (similar means Any type of Tablet PCs/Hand Held Terminal Devices with minimum 3 GB RAM and Minimum 32 GB storage ROM) for a quantity of 20 percent or more of tendere d quantity against a single contract during last three years prior to, an d excluding bid opening date may be considered as responsive to SC R ailways requirements for placement of bulk and regular order. The onu s of submission of requisite supply performance documents i.e. CRAC/ Receipt Notes/Proof of acceptance of material by consignee along with concerned Purchase order shall be on bidder. [B] In case, the bidder does not submit the requisite documents, as det ailed above, along with their offer, no back reference shall be made an d offer shall be evaluated on the basis of uploaded documents except f or the situation, (i) wherein the supply performance exist for Hand Hel d Terminal Devices in South Central Railway for Stock item, as availabl e in IMMIS, or (ii) situation where only related shortfall documents are not available in bid offer which may be asked and considered. For exa mple, if the bidder has submitted a supply order without its completion /performance certificate, the certificate can be asked for and considere d subject to condition that supply performance is not post bid opening date. However, no new supply order or proof of supply (which was not part of initial bid) should be submitted by the bidder, post tender openi ng, so as to qualify the bidder and those documents will not be conside red at post bid opening stage. [C] In case, the tenderer participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as required above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authori zing the agent or bidder for the same OEM. It may so happen that the a

gent/dealer has credentials of past supply for a different Principal/OEM but this will not be considered as performance for placing bulk order in case of change of Principal/OEM who have authorized in this bid. [D] For Authorized dealer, bid specific authorization from OEM has to be uploaded with bid indicating GeM bid number and da te, Complete address of OEM, Designation of Authorizing perso n of OEM like name etc. in bid in OEM letterhead. [E] Participating bidders must mention the make/brand and model offe red. Bids received without make/brands or with vague mentions like "0 ", NIL, "as per tender" etc will be summarily rejected. Participating firm s should mention their offered make/brand with the model (if required) against tendered item in the corresponding make/brand column withou t fail. Ambiguity in the form of offering multiple make/brands or not me ntioning make/brand will be treated as disadvantage to the bidder and such offer is liable to be rejected. Bidders should also furnish the produ ct catalogue of the item offered. 7. GST: Please refer to Clause 8 of GeM GTC hyperlinked with the bid documen t. Buyer shall raise invoice for S.C. Railway (Telangana) GST No.: 36AA AGM0289C1ZK for Telangana based consignee and S.C. Railway (AP) G ST No.: 37AAAGM0289C1ZI for Andhra Pradesh based Consignee. 8. Delivery Period and Extension Of Delivery: Time is the essence of Contract Please refer Clause 14 & 15 of GeM GT C hyperlinked with bid . 9. Failure of Contract & Recoverable Damages : If the Seller fails to supply goods as per GeM contract within Delivery p eriod or extended delivery period or at any time repudiates the contrac t before the expiry of delivery period, Buyer reserves the right to canc el the GeM contract for unsupplied portion, record adverse performanc e of the bidder for taking appropriate administrative action (a) through incident Management of GeM (b) rejection of offer on account of bad performance in ensuing bids inv ited by buyer, (c) forfeit the security deposit( ePBG) or initiate recoveries outstanding for an amount equivalent to applicable Security Deposit for undelivere d portion.

(d) In severable contracts, in case of failure by the seller to meet deliv eries for any lot, Railways may cancel the contract for defaulted part b y forfeiting SD commensurate with that lot or initiating recoveries for a n amount equivalent to Security Deposit /PBG for undelivered portion. 10. Removal of Rejected Goods: Bidders shall refer Clause 11(iv) of GeM GTC hyperlinked with bid. No p ayment shall be made for rejected goods or services. After intimation o f the rejection / part rejection by the Buyer/ Consignee, the Seller shall be liable to remove / lift back such rejected Goods within 10 days witho ut any extra charge/cost to the Buyer / Consignee failing which suitabl e ground rent / warehousing charges would be payable by the Seller to the Buyer/Consignee. If the Seller fails to remove / lift back such reject ed Goods within reasonable time period, the Buyer / Consignee shall h ave the right to dispose-off such rejected goods at the risk and cost of the seller. 11. Warranty Period: Warranty Period for the GeM Bid is as per Annexure-1 enclosed: 04 Yea rs Comprehensive OEM Warranty including battery. This warranty perio d supersedes the Default warranty period of 1 year for the items listed in this category on GeM for this GeM Bid. The same is also mentioned in the Additional Specifications Pt. No.11. with firmware upgradation. Firm to quote accordingly. 12. SAMPLE CLAUSE: (a) After award of contract, the successful bidder shall have to get adv ance samples approved from SCM/Resv./HQ/PCCM Office for testing it i n working scenario before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 3 samples for consignee approval, withi n 15 days of award of contract. (b) SCM/Resv./HQ/PCCM Office shall, as per contract specifications fra mework, either approve the advance samples or will provide a complet e list of modification required in the sample within 7 days of receipt of advance sample. The offered device will be accepted only after a samp le is successfully tested in working scenario. (c) Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample wi th modifications as communicated by SCM/Resv./HQ/PCCM Office. If th

ere is delay from consignee side in approval of advance samples the d elivery period shall be re-fixed without penalty for the period of delay i n sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviatio ns / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer/Consignee at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviatio ns to the seller and forfeit SD or recover equivalent amount of SD as re coveries in case SD is exempted. (d) Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for t est shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the co ntract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any ex penses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the producti on of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved uncondition ally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensati on in the event of such samples being found unacceptable by the Buye r / Consignee. 13. Arbitration Clause: The GeM contract will be governed by the arbitration clause, as per Par a 2900: SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTES in Annexure-A of Railway board lett er No. 2018/TF/Civil/Arbitration Policy dated 12.12.2018 (copy of which is enclosed with the bid in the "Buyer uploaded ATC document"). This i s in supersession to the "Arbitration Clause" mentioned in the "Bid Det ails". 13A. Submission of Technical / Commercial Deviations: (1) The bidder shall carefully examine all the provisions of the Bid Docu ment, including the Technical Specifications, Scope of Supply, Buyer a dded bid specific ATC, General Terms and Conditions (GTC) of GeM, del ivery requirements, warranty obligations and all other stipulated terms and conditions before submission of the bid. (2) Any deviation, exception, variation, qualification or reservation proposed by the bidder against any technical specification or commerc ial/contractual condition of the bid shall be explicitly and unambiguousl y indicated in the prescribed "Deviation Statement" Annexure encl osed with the bid. Each proposed deviation shall be separately listed, with specific reference to the relevant clause/specification number, the original stipulated requirement and the precise alternative provision pr

oposed by the bidder, along with adequate justification and supporting technical documents, wherever applicable. (3) In case the bidder does not propose any deviation, the Deviation St atement Annexure shall be submitted duly signed, clearly indicating " NIL DEVIATION". Non-submission of the prescribed Deviation Statem ent Annexure shall not be construed as permission to submit deviation s at a subsequent stage. (4) Any deviation, qualification, condition or reservation indicated in an y other part of the bid, including the technical compliance statement, t echnical literature, product brochures, commercial offer, covering lette r or any other document, but not specifically and explicitly disclosed in the prescribed Deviation Statement Annexure, shall not be considered as an accepted deviation and shall not override the requirements of th e Bid Document. (5) No deviation shall be deemed to have been accepted merel y by its disclosure or submission. All deviations shall be subject to examination and specific written acceptance by the Competent Authori ty of South Central Railway, wherever such acceptance is permissible u nder the applicable procurement rules and GeM provisions. Deviations affecting essential, mandatory or material requirements of the bid, or r esulting in a material alteration of the scope, specifications, contractua l obligations or commercial terms, shall not be entertained. (6) Any deviation or conditional offer which renders the bid non-respon sive, materially alters the stipulated requirements or makes the offer a mbiguous or conditional may render the bid liable for rejection, in acco rdance with the applicable GeM provisions and the terms of the Bid Do cument. (7) The Deviation Statement shall be duly signed by the authorised sig natory of the bidder and shall form an integral part of the bid. The bidd er shall remain fully responsible for the accuracy, completeness and co nsistency of the deviations declared therein. 14. Mandatory Documents to be uploaded with offer: a. EMD or EMD Exemption document in the relevant section of

GeM. b. Past performance documents as specified in clause 6 of ATC. c. Local content percentage with address of local content addit ion. d. OEM bid specific authorization (if applicable) e. Warranty Guarantee certificate of the OEM as requested in c lause 20.4 of Annexure-6 (Special Terms and Conditions). f. Technical Compliance Certificate as per Annexure-1 of OEM. g. Complaint escalation/Service centers declaration as per Poin t No. 12 of Annexure-6 attached with this bid by OEM/its autho rized agent. h. Software / application support/Updates and compatibility de claration from the OEM/ its authorized agent as per Point no. 1 3 of Annexure-6 attached with this bid. i. Deviation Statement Annexure 15. List of other Documents to be uploaded with offer for verifi cation by consignee: a. User manuals b. Technical Catalogue of the offered HHTs 16. Technical specifications of the HHT device should be strictl y as per Annexure-1 document attached with this bid documen t. In case of any ambiguity w.r.t any specification parameter between golden/non-golden parameters, additional specification parameters an d Annexure-1 document, the Annexure-1 document will supersed e/prevail. Bidders must go through the attached document very caref ully. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
